steps.content: After this eccentric adventure, everyone returns to the "filming studio" they had come to earlier.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: The Gonzales people are gone now... They won't come back, will they?

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Hard to say...
Lil Daisy casts a glance at Diego next to her.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh well, no matter. In any case, the crisis has been temporarily resolved. Though we met many dangers along the way, we're lucky to have Love's incredible courage, which finally drove away Francisco the baddy daddy...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Indeed, indeed! DeadLover Radio is the best!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hahahahaha, I knew that my charm is unparalleled! Even kids can't resist it.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: ..Don't be a bad influence on the kid. We didn't do anything worthwhile this whole time.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Who says you didn't do anything worthwhile?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Syndicate is so chaotic and terrifying, and you were being hunted down by a bunch of baddies.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yet you remained cheerful and never complained. Not only were you happy yourselves, but you also shared that happiness with others.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want my movie to be like that, too! You guys are my idols!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: ...Hehe, oh shucks, I feel embarrassed now. We're not that great...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You are! Love, you're the best! I'm your number one fan now!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Daisy... Daisy is... Daisy is the third best. OwO is the second best.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: ...Okay.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: By the way, OwO, are you still recruiting people for your crew?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yeah! Wanna come, too, Love?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Of course! The movie we're making is so fun. There's nothing more fun in all of Syndicate!

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Sticking to the principle of being wherever's most fun, I'm gonna stay with you no matter what.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yeah! That's great!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: What about the radio station? The building burned down, and all our staff ran away. It'll take a lot to rebuild.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: No worries. Having fun in the present is more important! We can think about rebuilding the radio station later.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Plus, we were going to make a "DisCars Special" anyways. We're getting the best materials out of this.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: When OwO finishes making her fun movie, we'll go onstage at the DisCars together, and I'll announce...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: OwO has not only made the best ******* movie in all of DisCity, but she is also an honorary employee of DeadLover Radio and Love's number one fan. What do you think? It's gonna be super fun.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: No problem! I've got things covered!
As the two get more and more excited as they chat, Daisy starts getting a headache.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: The Gonzales henchmen are still... Never mind.
Lil Daisy looks at OwO, then at Love.

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Maybe it's safer to stay with you... So be it...
